back.en: Open: blood in body cavities (insects). Closed: blood always in vessels (fish, humans)
back.bm: Terbuka: darah dalam rongga badan (serangga). Tertutup: darah sentiasa dalam salur (ikan, manusia)

back.en: Single: fish (heart → gills → body). Double: mammals (pulmonary + systemic)
back.bm: Tunggal: ikan (jantung → insang → badan). Ganda dua: mamalia (pulmonari + sistemik)

back.en: Plasma (55%), red blood cells, white blood cells, platelets
back.bm: Plasma (55%), sel darah merah, sel darah putih, platlet

back.en: Tricuspid (right), bicuspid (left), semilunar (aorta, pulmonary artery) — stop backflow
back.bm: Trikuspid (kanan), bikuspid (kiri), sabit (aorta, arteri pulmonari) — halang aliran balik

back.en: Pulmonary: heart ↔ lungs. Systemic: heart ↔ rest of body
back.bm: Pulmonari: jantung ↔ peparu. Sistemik: jantung ↔ seluruh badan

back.en: SA node in the right atrium; myogenic — heart muscle starts its own beat
back.bm: Nodus SA di atrium kanan; miogenik — otot jantung memulakan degupannya sendiri

back.en: Medulla oblongata via nerves; adrenaline increases heart rate
back.bm: Medula oblongata melalui saraf; adrenalina meningkatkan kadar degupan jantung

back.en: Thromboplastin → prothrombin to thrombin → fibrinogen to fibrin → clot
back.bm: Tromboplastin → protrombin ke trombin → fibrinogen ke fibrin → beku

back.en: A (antigen A, anti-B), B (antigen B, anti-A), AB (both antigens, no antibodies), O (no antigens, both antibodies)
back.bm: A (antigen A, anti-B), B (antigen B, anti-A), AB (kedua-dua antigen, tiada antibodi), O (tiada antigen, kedua-dua antibodi)

back.en: Rh+ has the Rh antigen; an Rh− mother can make antibodies against an Rh+ baby
back.bm: Rh+ mempunyai antigen Rh; ibu Rh− boleh menghasilkan antibodi terhadap bayi Rh+

back.en: Atherosclerosis, arteriosclerosis, hypertension, heart attack, stroke
back.bm: Aterosklerosis, arteriosklerosis, hipertensi, serangan jantung, strok

back.en: Lymph vessels, lymph nodes, spleen, thymus — returns tissue fluid, filters germs, absorbs fats
back.bm: Salur limfa, nodus limfa, limpa, timus — kembalikan bendalir tisu, tapis kuman, serap lemak
